flows.title: Update a lead
steps: Sign in, find the lead, and click its name to open the lead record.
Click Edit and change the fields to update. Optionally select Assign using active assignment rule to reassign the lead by that rule.
To change the status of several leads at once in Lightning Experience, select them in a list view and choose Change Status from the Action menu.

flows.title: Convert a qualified lead
steps: Sign in, open the lead record, and choose to convert the lead. A conversion cannot be reversed.
Enter a name for a new account, or select an existing account.
Select a contact, or enter a name for a new contact.
Enter a name for a new opportunity, or in Lightning Experience select an existing one. Up to 20 matching opportunities are listed.
Convert the lead, and optionally create a follow-up task.

flows.title: Take leads from a queue
steps: Sign in and go to a list view that shows a lead queue. If there is none, an admin has to add you as a queue member.
Select the leads you want to own and click Accept.
To reassign a single lead from a queue, open its record detail page and change the record owner.
